note: Curated short names for scripts/icons.mjs. icon = <set>:<name>; the sets are pinned in scripts/icons.mjs: logos (Gil Barbara, CC0, full colour, read from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gilbarbara/logos at a pinned commit) is the source of every colour brand mark; si (Simple Icons, one colour in the brand hex) only where no colour mark exists (Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Chat, Tasks, Calendly ...); file (vscode-icons) for file types, ui (Lucide) for glyphs. theSVG was dropped (no verified licence per mark). boxes = the measured drawing box of each colour mark (icons.mjs measure).

logos.use: full-colour brand marks, served from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gilbarbara/logos at this commit (the repository has no tags)

si.use: one-colour brand marks in the brand hex: only where logos has no colour mark
